title: Replace the UI and typography with @zonsh/ui
body:
Replace the board's UI and typography with **@zonsh/ui**, the zon design system.

- `@zonsh/ui` lives in `~/projects/ui` (`packages/ui`), published on npm (0.5.0). It is **React** (Base UI + Tailwind v4); the board UI (`apps/desktop`) is **SvelteKit + Svelte 5**, so this is a port of the desktop UI to React, not a restyle. Agree the approach with Malik before starting.
- Read `~/projects/ui/AGENTS.md` and `~/projects/ui/docs/brand.md` first: monochrome surfaces, colour only for meaning, the three Licht faces (Licht for headlines at weight 300, Licht Sans for reading and controls, Licht Mono for labels and numbers), fixed heights (30/38/46) and radii.
- Keep the daemon's REST/WebSocket API and everything the board does: lists, tickets, drag and drop, the forum, search (Ctrl/Cmd+F, `T` + number), notifications, settings, the git-graph history.
- The built UI is embedded into the `wipe` binary from `crates/wipe-daemon/assets` (`scripts/embed-ui`), and rebuilding the binary needs Rust, which isn't installed on seireitei yet.
